selector.runner_up: Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) with Giant R-wave Syndrome
selector.rationale: Evidence of diffuse stenosis in proximal to mid-LAD and 80% stenosis in mid-right coronary artery supports CAD, while the presence of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia and QTc of 403 milliseconds could suggest a subtype like CAD with Giant R-wave Syndrome, but the primary diagnosis of CAD is more directly supported by the coronary angiography findings.

rejected.label: Long QT Syndrome
rejected.why: QTc of 403 milliseconds is not significantly prolonged to strongly support Long QT Syndrome

rejected.label: Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: No specific evidence of right ventricular dysfunction or fibrofatty replacement is mentioned

rejected.label: Ischemic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Left ventricular ejection fraction of 58% does not indicate significant cardiomyopathy

rejected.label: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: No evidence of hypertrophy or asymmetric septal hypertrophy is provided
